status.en: 18 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 36% fewer than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 18 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 36 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Qatar’s intelligence chief says the country revamped its entire defence system in six hours, while Turkish troops will remain in Syria and Iraq until border security is ensured. Syrian security forces carried out operations that dismantled an ISIS mercenary cell and killed a member of the Defence Ministry in Eastern Ghouta, and a civilian was killed during an Israeli operation in Syria. The Syrian People’s Assembly is advancing a broad legislative overhaul covering employment, penal, property and national security law, and a British aid worker’s daughter continues searching for her father’s body after his death in Syria. 2,732 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Qatars etterretningssjef sier landet revurderte hele forsvarssystemet på seks timer, mens tyrkiske tropper vil bli i Syria og Irak til grensesikkerheten er sikret. Syriske sikkerhetsstyrker gjennomførte operasjoner som demonterte en IS-leiesoldatcelle og drepte et medlem av Forsvarsdepartementet i Øst-Ghouta, og en sivil ble drept under en israelsk operasjon i Syria. Den syriske folkeforsamlingen fremmer en omfattende lovreform som dekker arbeids‑, straff‑, eiendoms‑ og nasjonal sikkerhetslov, og datteren til en britisk hjelpearbeider fortsetter å lete etter farens lik etter hans død i Syria. 2 732 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
